review_candidates.title: Product Experience Designer (UX/UI)
review_candidates.description: At Educatly , we’re building a Life Design Intelligence Network that helps individuals discover their passions, explore career possibilities, and connect with learning paths that shape their future. As AI transforms how digital products are imagined, designed, and built, we’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer who combines exceptional creativity, strong product thinking, and hands-on AI capabilities to help us build the next generation of intelligent, intuitive, and impactful product experiences. This isn't just a UI/UX role. We’re looking for someone who can challenge conventional thinking, turn complex problems into elegant solutions, and use AI to push the boundaries of what’s possible in product design. What You’ll Own 1. End-to-End Product Experience Design Design intuitive, engaging user journeys across web and mobile products. Translate complex user needs and business challenges into simple, effective experiences. Improve onboarding, activation, usability, and decision-making flows. Think beyond screens to shape the overall product experience. 2. AI-Powered Design & Prototyping Integrate AI tools into your daily design workflow to accelerate execution and unlock new creative possibilities. Use AI-assisted prototyping and experimentation to turn ideas into testable experiences quickly. Explore emerging AI design tools and workflows to challenge traditional design processes. Leverage AI for UX research synthesis, ideation, wireframing, interface exploration, and rapid iteration where appropriate. Continuously experiment with new ways to improve design quality, speed, and product outcomes. Strong AI capabilities are a must-have for this role. We want someone who actively experiments with AI, understands how to apply it meaningfully, and can demonstrate how it improves their design process—not someone who simply uses AI to generate visuals. Tools may include Claude, Figma AI, Lovable, ChatGPT, AI prototyping platforms, and other emerging tools. 3. Creative Problem-Solving & Product Innovation Bring fresh ideas and creative approaches to product challenges. Challenge existing assumptions and explore alternative solutions. Translate abstract concepts into compelling, interactive product experiences. Balance creativity, usability, technical feasibility, and business impact. Stay curious about emerging technologies and global product design trends. 4. UI Excellence & Design Systems Create polished, modern interfaces with strong visual hierarchy, typography, interaction patterns, and attention to detail. Build and evolve Educatly’s design system to ensure consistency and scalability. Maintain a high standard of visual quality across products and platforms. Deliver clear, developer-ready design specifications and handoffs. 5. Continuous UX Improvement Identify friction points and opportunities to improve the user experience. Use user feedback, product data, and experimentation to inform design decisions. Iterate continuously to improve clarity, engagement, and usability. 6. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with the Head of Engineering , product strategy, the Life Design Intelligence team, and Data to turn ideas into scalable, high-quality product experiences. You’ll be expected to take ownership, communicate your thinking clearly, and collaborate closely with engineering to bring ambitious ideas to life. What We’re Looking For Must-Have Qualifications 4+ years of experience in Product Design, UX/UI, or a closely related role. Strong product thinking and the ability to solve problems beyond the interface. Advanced proficiency in Figma and modern product design workflows. Demonstrated hands-on experience with AI-powered design, ideation, and prototyping tools. Ability to move from concept to prototype quickly and iterate based on feedback. Strong UX fundamentals, including user flows, information architecture, interaction design, and usability. Excellent visual design skills, paired with creativity and a strong sense of product quality. A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with the ability to work independently. A strong portfolio is mandatory and must demonstrate your design process, problem-solving abilities, shipped or realistic product experiences, and use of AI where applicable. Strong Plus & Preferred Qualifications Experience with SaaS products, complex platforms, or multi-sided marketplaces. Experience in EdTech, learning, career development, or AI-powered products. Experience building and maintaining scalable design systems. Familiarity with front-end constraints and developer handoff. Experience using AI-assisted prototyping tools to validate ideas before development. The Ideal Candidate You’re someone who: Thinks creatively and strategically , not just visually. Uses AI as a practical tool to expand capabilities, accelerate workflows, and explore better solutions. Can transform ambiguous problems into clear, intuitive product experiences. Has the curiosity to experiment and the judgment to know which ideas are worth pursuing. Moves quickly without compromising quality. Takes ownership of the experience from the first idea through implementation. Understands that great product design combines user needs, technology, creativity, and business impact. Why Join Educatly? You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing product ecosystem at the intersection of education, career discovery, life design, and AI—with room to experiment, challenge conventions, and influence how our products evolve. How to Apply If this sounds like you, we’d love to see your work. Send your portfolio to humanresources@educatly.com with the subject line: Product Experience Designer – [Your Name] . Please note: A portfolio is mandatory for screening and progression to the next stages of our hiring process. We’re particularly interested in seeing how you think, how you solve problems, and how you use AI to enhance your design capabilities. Let’s build experiences that help people design their futures.

review_candidates.title: AI-First Social Media Analyst
review_candidates.description: 🇪🇬 Up to EUR 7,000 per year, on a full time, contractor contract 🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Egypt! ✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment 💻 Work with modern hardware, social publishing tools, productivity systems, and AI-enabled workflows. Who We Are At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients. Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work — we're right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation. This Is an AI-First Role We're not looking for someone who occasionally asks ChatGPT to tidy up a sentence. We're looking for an analyst who treats AI as the default way to work. Social analytics is full of repetitive, high-volume work: pulling data, normalising it, spotting patterns, writing it up, formatting it, doing it again next month. That work is now largely automatable — and the analysts who automate it spend their time on the part that actually matters, which is judgement, interpretation and telling clients something they didn't already know. You'll be expected to build that automation yourself, not wait for someone to build it for you. Every recurring task you touch should get faster the second time you do it. To be direct about the trade: AI does the grunt work, you own the accuracy. We hold AI-assisted output to a higher standard than manual output, not a lower one — because a hallucinated number in a client report is worse than a slow one. What You’ll Make Happen Collaborating with fellow analysts and other internal teams, you'll take part in: Contributing to a variety of client-facing insights reports Gathering and analysing performance data from social media networks, in accordance with our processes Developing a mastery of a variety of analytics tools, including Sprinklr, Sprout Social, Meta Business Suite and YouTube Studio Building AI-assisted workflows that take reporting tasks from hours to minutes — data cleaning, first-pass analysis, chart generation, draft narratives, QA checks Using LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT and similar) as an analytical partner — interrogating datasets, pressure-testing your own conclusions, generating and discarding hypotheses fast Rigorously verifying AI output before it reaches a client — checking numbers against source, catching confident-but-wrong claims, knowing where these tools are unreliable Creating visually appealing and consistently designed reports and presentations Generating content and strategy recommendations from data analysis of our clients' social accounts Compiling those recommendations into a written format to be shared with external stakeholders Turning what you build into something the whole team can use — documenting prompts, workflows and automations so they become team assets rather than personal shortcuts Continuously looking for areas of improvement and working with the team to improve the overall quality of our reports and provide more value to our clients Updating and maintaining documentation on our reporting processes Following client and competitor accounts on social media to better understand effective social media strategy Your Expertise Excellent numeracy skills and ability to analyse data quantitatively and qualitatively Genuine hands-on experience using AI tools in real work — not just awareness of them. Tell us what you've built, automated or sped up, and what didn't work Healthy scepticism — you can spot when a model is confidently wrong, and you check before you send Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills Excellent written and communication skills Unparalleled attention to detail Ability to prioritise workload and complete tasks to deadlines Social media experience is a plus, but not a necessity if you're interested in learning about the industry Nice to Haves Experience in creating and executing on social media performance reports Experience with 3rd party social analytics tools, such as Sprout Social, Sprinklr, Social Insider Experience with the social networks' native analytics tools, such as Facebook Creator Studio, YouTube Studio, TikTok Analytics Light scripting ability (Python, SQL, Apps Script) — or the confidence to get there with AI assistance Experience with automation tooling (Zapier, Make, n8n) or agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, custom GPTs) A side project, script or workflow you built because something annoyed you What It's Like to Work Here Cutting-Edge Tools & Tech Work with the latest hardware and software — Windows or Mac — plus paid access to frontier AI tools, and the freedom to experiment with new ones. Ideas Welcome, Always We don't just say we're open to ideas — we act on them. Your insights can shape how we work across the company. Fast, Agile, Adaptive We move like a start-up but with the backing of a larger team. Quick decisions and a responsive culture are the norm. Incredible Team, Global Reach Join an international crew of 175+ passionate, talented people. We hire for skill, drive, and authenticity — just be yourself. Remote-First & Flexible Fully remote within South Africa. Our usual working hours are between 9am and 5.30pm GMT, but we offer flexible working arrangements with start times from 8am GMT and end times up to 7pm GMT. Recruitment Process First, you will receive questions to self-record a video response. We will then invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Vanessa, our Analytics Manager, will get to know you and try to understand if you'd be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions. After the initial interview, you may be sent a short reporting task to complete (if you're open to it). You're encouraged to use AI on it — we're interested in how you use it, not whether you use it. And that's it! Not sure if you tick every box? Apply anyway — we care more about your potential and mindset than a perfect match.

review_candidates.title: Graduate Software Engineer, DevOps 2027
review_candidates.description: Location: Bristol, UK Start date: September 2027 Application deadline : Midnight, 29th November 2026 We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline. The Graduate Programme at Graphcore Join Graphcore in a permanent role and start your career with two years of hands-on learning. From day one, you’ll be trusted to take ownership, share your ideas and help shape what we’re creating. You’ll tackle challenging problems alongside a team who support your development and are as excited about your success as you are. What you’ll work on Put your coding skills to work on the infrastructure that helps Graphcore engineers turn code into reliable software releases. As a Graduate Software Engineer in DevOps, you’ll help develop and maintain tools for software builds and releases. You’ll deploy services using Kubernetes and Docker, and support cloud infrastructure managed through tools such as Terraform. Working closely with teams developing Graphcore’s machine learning software stack, you’ll help automate repetitive tasks and improve the workflows engineers use every day. You’ll join the Software Infrastructure team, building tools that help Graphcore engineers develop, test and release software for their state-of-the-art AI accelerators. An engineering buddy will help you settle in, with senior engineers, tech leads and your manager supporting you as you grow. In your first three months, you’ll work with fellow graduates on a project developing new capability that goes into production. It’ll be something you can point to and say, “We built that”, and continue to own, develop, and maintain long-term. Previous graduates have rolled out ArgoCD to manage the lifecycle of our entire kubernetes estate and Coder to provide development environments for engineers. Coder remains our second highest volume service to this day. Bring your questions and ideas. Take responsibility for your work and speak up when you spot a problem or need support. How you’ll learn and grow During the two-year programme, you’ll build practical experience in continuous integration and deployment, cloud infrastructure, containerisation, build engineering and release systems, and machine learning operations. You’ll see how software moves from development to release and learn what it takes to make that possible at scale. You’ll develop the judgement to understand what people need, weigh up different approaches and build solutions they can depend on. Your manager understands the potential graduates bring and will help you build on your foundations, developing the skills and confidence to take on more complex engineering challenges. What we're looking for Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Maths, Machine Learning, Data Science or a related field Knowledge of Python, Go, C++ or a similar programming language. Experience developing or managing systems in Linux environments An understanding of continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with the communication skills to explain your work and collaborate with others You can demonstrate these skills through coursework, a dissertation, personal or team projects, research, or other relevant experience. Tell us what you built or investigated, how you approached it and what you learned. Exposure or experience in Kubernetes, OpenStack, infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or OpenTofu, GitHub Actions, build tools, high-performance computing (HPC), Grafana or cloud services such as AWS would be useful. These are additional strengths, rather than essential requirements. Benefits Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. Sponsorship Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the programme, without requiring visa sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor work visas for our Early Careers opportunities. Introduction to Graphcore At Graphcore, we’re building next generation AI compute: from semiconductors and software to systems at datacenter scale. We are proud to be owned by SoftBank Group and work with other companies in the SoftBank family to deliver AI compute to customers working at the AI frontier. Starting your career here means working alongside people with different backgrounds and expertise, from AI researchers to chip designers and software engineers. You’ll learn from each other, bring fresh ideas and help solve challenging problems together. How To Apply And What To Expect To apply, answer the application questions below and upload your CV and cover letter. We’ll let you know the outcome of your application by early December at the latest. If successful, you’ll be invited to complete a technical assessment. Candidates who reach the final stage will then be invited to attend in-person assessments in early spring. Ready to put your learning into practice? Start your career in a permanent DevOps role, with two years of hands-on learning through the Graphcore Graduate Programme. Apply now and help shape what comes next.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer (Remote)
review_candidates.description: About GiveDirectly What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need? Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid. Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty? We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join. We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress. How We Work Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated: Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress. If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit. Want to learn more? Read and listen: We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take. You must be based in one of the countries on this list and must overlap with East Africa Time and US Eastern Time (8am-6pm) by at least 3 hours. As an example, 6PM East Africa Time is 11AM US Eastern time in the summer and 10AM in the winter. In practice, if you are in the Eastern US timezone, that means being regularly available for 8AM meetings and some 7AM ones. We know people have commitments like school drop-offs, so you’re encouraged to set a schedule that works for you—as long as there’s sufficient overlap with the team. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time. About This Role Technology plays a central role in how GiveDirectly delivers cash—whether that’s identifying recipients in hard-to-reach places, sending payments quickly after disasters, or powering the platforms our donors use to give. We’re Hiring a Senior Software Engineer To Help Build The Systems Behind This Work. Our Engineering Team Still Operates Like a Startup Within GiveDirectly—lean, Fast-moving, And High-autonomy. You’ll Lean Into Product Thinking, Help Shape The Roadmap, And Collaborate Closely Across Disciplines To Solve Real-world Problems. The Specific Team You’ll Join Is Still Being Finalized—it Could Be Our Programs Engineering team (getting cash in the hands of people experiencing extreme poverty), Our Fundraising Engineering team (raising more money for recipients), or Our International Rapid Response team (getting cash to disaster-affected communities within 5 days of a crisis—anywhere in the world) No matter the team, you’ll play a central role in scaling our impact: getting more money, to more people, more efficiently. This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You’ll help shape architecture, ship production-ready code, and work side-by-side with teammates across product, data, and operations. We’re looking for someone excited to wear multiple hats, move quickly, and define what great engineering looks like in a mission-driven org Level: Senior Software Engineer Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel ~1-2 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or field visits. What You’ll Do Design and build scalable, reliable systems that power our core operations—whether that’s donor platforms, systems that deliver payments directly to recipients, or crisis response tools reaching hundreds of thousands of people globally. Own end-to-end development of new features and services, from architecture through deployment and monitoring. Improve our developer workflows by strengthening CI/CD pipelines, reducing manual steps, and increasing test coverage. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, ops, data) to understand real-world needs and ship tools that directly support program delivery in the field. Debug and resolve production issues across our stack, with a focus on root cause analysis and long-term fixes. Advocate for sustainable engineering practices, including testing, documentation, and monitoring Help shape our tech roadmap with an eye toward scale, maintainability, and recipient experience What You’ll Bring Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity.
